modelingNotes: Exact 24050 row: C60N, 1P, 10 A, B curve. Diagram E45092 establishes terminal markings 1 and 2; accessories are separately ordered.

B curve magnetic operation 3–5 In, calibrated at 30 °C. IEC 60947-2 1P Icu: 10 kA at 230–240 V AC; 3 kA at 400–415 V AC only for IT isolated-neutral double fault. IEC 60898 table: 6 kA at 230/400 V. Voltage capability is not encoded as an assigned nominal voltage; no DC suitability conclusion is made.
Tunnel-terminal cable capacity at this rating: 16 mm² flexible or 25 mm² rigid. Terminal positions follow the diagram, without imposing feed direction.

Open contact represents the catalog drawing, not an asserted installed state. The breaker does not permanently join its terminals; trip dynamics and coordination are not simulated. Connections are application-dependent.

connectionCoverage.notes: Bare 24050: one protected pole with two tunnel terminals, 1 and 2, per A10 schematic E45092. No neutral, PE, auxiliary or communication connection; separately ordered auxiliaries and Vigi modules excluded.
